scope: Selected lifetime chronology; not an exhaustive CV.

events.event: Played snare drum in the Mocidade Alegre samba-school percussion section.
Studied at Conservatório Antonino Simalha.
Founded Coitado do Próximo as composer and drummer.
Participated in BBS environments including SP Online/STI and Mandic; created the experimental Minduim BBS using RemoteAccess and two telephone lines.
Maintained a cultural column on Tremonte BBS.
Presented and curated the weekday Metrópole radio program on Rádio Nova Paulista FM 103.7.
Coitado do Próximo recorded the demo Pegue o seu Celular / Mulher SP; Marcelo Nicchio was interviewed by Kid Vinil on 97FM; the band opened for 365 at Aeroanta.
Recorded the first Coitado do Próximo album, Meu Querido Diário, at Estúdio Asas, produced by Edson X.
Worked in executive production/fundraising for Homens na Cozinha, broadcast by Band.
events.evidence: autobiographical; external credits to be checked

events.event: Contributed through Nicchio & Associados to fundraising connected to the feature films Carandiru and Domésticas.
Pre-produced the second Coitado do Próximo album, Eu Não Tô Nem Aí, co-produced by Fábio Badi Crepaldi and Marcelo Nicchio.
Coitado do Próximo opened for Os Paralamas do Sucesso at Olympia in São Paulo.
Worked at PSINet in corporate hosting sales.
Appeared in Folhateen / Folha de S.Paulo in the edition whose printed cover line was Órfãos do Rock; internal article: Onde estão os ídolos?.
Coitado do Próximo appeared on Programa do Jô on Rede Globo and performed Estava Comigo, composed by Marcelo Nicchio.
Wrote the Prateleira Cultural column and other pieces for Sinal Verde magazine, including recurring digital-culture topics such as RSS, Skype/VoIP, Google Earth, online radio and Orkut.
Created and operated Mirantte News; preserved contemporary material identifies Marcelo Nicchio as director of the portal.
Credited for Artistic Direction and co-Executive Production of Meia-Noite e Uns on RedeTV!; Dreamsnetwork.tv identified as production entity.
Deepened professional work in SEM and completed certifications under the Google Advertising Professional program.
Worked at CookieWEB, progressing from SEM coordination to management.
Worked at Petlove on the internalization of digital media operations.
Developed Clickland Digital, an agency focused on small and medium-sized businesses, created with Carlos Portela.
events.evidence: preserved website/business material plus autobiographical founder detail

events.event: Worked at BEST within the Kenshoo ecosystem and taught advanced Search and Social segmentation workshops for E-Commerce Brasil.
Worked at Ad.Dialetto, including work connected to Máquina de Vendas / Ricardo Eletro.
Developing O Arquiteto da Apoteose, a documentary project about Sidnei França; unfinished work in progress.
Developed the Autópsia content/television project during the pandemic; project not released.
Worked remotely at Driven.CX.
Coitado do Próximo reunited for a surprise performance at Cassasp.
Began the current independent Human–AI Interaction research cycle.
Published four Melissa 1.0 research works on Zenodo, each with its own DOI.
Released The Punk Rock Orchestra v1, with instances on OSF, SSRN, Zenodo, PubPub and GitHub.
Developing Punk Rock Orchestra v2 as the intended definitive version closing the current Melissa → PRO research cycle.
events.note: No future DOI, repository deposit or formal publication is asserted until it exists publicly.
